# Johto

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Johto has 35 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from Crystal.

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges. Johto, Sinnoh and Paldea change with the clock: morning is 04:00-10:00, day 10:00-18:00, night 18:00-04:00 (a board with no clock counts as day).

#### Gym 1: Falkner (Violet) -- the Zephyr Badge
Flying specialist. 2 Pokemon, best level 9: your team fights at level 9 at most, and on hard you bring 2 at most. Prize money: $450 on easy, $900 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pidgey | Normal/Flying | 7 | Tackle |
| Pidgeotto | Normal/Flying | 9 | Gust, Tackle |

**Hit them with** Rock, Ice, Electric moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Flying. **Tested team:** Tentacruel, Aipom, Teddiursa, Heracross, Poliwhirl, Phanpy. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Johto by this point, raised to level 9 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 2).

#### Gym 2: Bugsy (Azalea) -- the Hive Badge
Bug specialist. 3 Pokemon, best level 16: your team fights at level 16 at most, and on hard you bring 3 at most. Prize money: $800 on easy, $1,600 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|

Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Johto by this point, raised to level 16 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 3).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).
